today.hud.title: Readiness reading
today.hud.note: This reading reflects today's logged inputs only. A single day carries little signal on its own — what matters clinically is the 30-day trend, visible on the Analytics tab.
today.streak.title: Logging consistency, this week
today.streak.note: Consistent daily logs make the trend lines on Analytics meaningful. Gaps get marked on the chart rather than guessed at.
today.nutrition.note: Preset food values are per-100g USDA FoodData Central figures, scaled to a typical portion — real servings vary. Tap a card to add its protein/zinc to today's total; long-press to subtract a misclick.
today.nutrition.tap_hint: Tap a food to add it
today.nutrition.browse_btn: + Browse more foods / add your own
today.nutrition.empty: Nothing logged yet for this date.
today.activity.title: Activity & mechanical load
today.sleep.title: Sleep & the overnight GH window
today.sleep.wakeups_sub: Disruptions to the first sleep cycle
today.sleep.gh_note: Most of a child's daily growth hormone release happens in the first deep-sleep cycle, roughly 60–90 minutes after sleep onset. Going to bed on time matters more than total hours.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Trend view — built to bring to a clinic visit
analytics.velocity.info: Height velocity calculated from the last two logged measurements. Reference range for this age: 4.2–6.0 cm/yr.
analytics.bmi.info: BMI-for-age, from the most recent measurement, using the WHO 2007 Reference (5–19 years). Amber mark = overweight cutoff (+1SD), red mark = obesity cutoff (+2SD). A screening signal, not a diagnosis — BMI can't distinguish muscle from fat.
analytics.target_height.title: Target height (mid-parental)
analytics.charts.growth_note: Shaded bands are the official WHO 2007 Growth Reference for school-age children and adolescents (5–19 years). This is a population reference, not a diagnosis.
analytics.charts.bmi_note: BMI-for-age using WHO's official reference. A screening signal, not a diagnosis — BMI can't distinguish muscle from fat.
